Name: Wumbus Wares (Hats and Furniture)
Author: ohitslunette
Description:
[quote][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#aae53d][size=4]Fear not, for Wumbus shall provide thee with bountiful itemes.[/size]
[/color][/font][/quote]
With this mod, you can now enjoy more Wumbus World items during your time in Stardew Valley.

Find three hats when you gain access to Hat Mouse. For the furniture, you have to accept Wumbus into your life first. Maybe watch his film or listen to music that makes you think of him, then check out Robin's shop [s](or get lucky from the Traveler's Cart/mines maybe)[/s].

[size=3][color=#aae53d]Installation Instructions[/color]
[/size]
[list]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b]﻿
[*]Download the latest version of this mod from the Files tab, and unzip it to your Mods folder
[*]You should be good to go 💚 Celebrate with a gluten dog or pizza 🍕
[/list][size=3]
[color=#aae53d]Recommended Mods[/color][/size][color=#93c47d]
[/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44507]Wumbumotes[/url] to embrace Wumbus even further while expressing yourself
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44509]Marriageable Wumbus[/url] to welcome Wumbus into your life [i]and[/i] home with open arms
[/list]
Mods Seen in Images: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39407]KookieFroggie's Recolor[/url] 💚 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38900]Font Smasher[/url] 💚 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39725]Awesome Font[/url] 💚 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414]They Deserve It Too[/url] 💚 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44507]Wumbumotes[/url]
[color=#29292e]
hehe Happy April Fool's (๑>؂•̀๑) thank you Stardew Valley Discord for inspiring this mod, introducing me to more of Wumbus' lore, and encouraging me to actually prefer Bobo more- Wumbus sold separately.[/color]
